choose.when: ai_task_step c JOIN ai_task_run r ON r.run_id=c.task_run_id
WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.user_id=#{userId} AND c.status='ACTIVE'

mapper.select: SELECT FROM ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT run_id,status,stream_key,conversation_id,question,error_message FROM ai_task_run WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND user_id=#{userId}
SELECT sources_json FROM ai_run_sources WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND run_id=#{runId}
SELECT content FROM ai_chat_message WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND run_id=#{runId} AND role='assistant'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_chat_conversation WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_chat_message WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND user_id=#{userId}

SELECT c.id,c.conversation_id,c.role,c.content,c.run_id,c.sequence_no,c.create_time, r.status AS run_status,s.sources_json FROM ai_chat_message c LEFT JOIN ai_task_run r ON r.run_id=c.run_id AND r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id LEFT JOIN ai_run_sources s ON s.run_id=c.run_id AND s.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND c.role='assistant' WHERE c.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY c.sequence_no ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
